items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1959-12-23
items.q: Oh, I use, sometimes I use manual seals and most of the time I use Fred Minor.

ctx.x: Oh, I use, sometimes I use manual seals and most of the time I use Fred Minor. He's not the greatest but he's a pretty good boy. I mean, he plays fair, you know, fair banjo and he sings a lot of tune, you know. He's a good entertainer, you know, entertain the people. That's why, you know, I have him with me all the time. I mean, I said banjo, well I'll call Fred Minor. And he loves to work with me because he figured when I get a gig, I mean, it's always going to be, you know, pretty good. But, you know, he…
How's this business of amplifying a guitar coming in?
